[[Memory of Sunrise]] is a trophy acquired by adding [[Sunrise]] to your account's [[Legendary Armory]]. It is used for creating [[Eternity]] in the [[Mystic Forge]].

== Acquisition ==
* Upon adding Sunrise to the Legendary Armory.
** This includes when Sunrise is automatically added to the Armory when logging in on a character with Sunrise equipped or account-bounded in the inventory for the first time after the release of the Legendary Armory on [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021]].

== Used in ==
{{recipe list}}

== Notes==
* An Eternity created from Memory of Sunrise and Memory of Twilight will be automatically bound to your Legendary Armory and can't be sold.
* Despite the item's description suggesting that it is interchangeable with [[Sunrise]], you cannot mystic forge it with [[Twilight]] and instead must forge it with [[Memory of Twilight]].
